Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma babaisbench · documents: The Baba Is Harbor README warns that oracle move strings are public and the game predates model training cutoffs, and distinguishes hinted and longer-clock variants from the base tasks.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.babaisbench.contamination.v2

  • The linked memorization audit was not read, so no claim of contamination-free results or validation of that audit is made.
  • Hints, time budgets and additional campaign stages are not counted as new logical benchmark families.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma babaisbench · dataset size: The cached BabaIsBench page describes an eight-level Intro arm with three attempts per model per level and a 60-minute limit per attempt, and a fifteen-level Lake arm run once per model with effectively no time limit.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.babaisbench.documented-arms.v3

  • The newer creator README lists 55 levels across stages 0–3; this is a different repository scope from the page’s two-arm 23-level evaluation, not an automatically reconciled current count.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

quesma babaisbench · evaluates: The Baba Is Harbor creator README describes JSON grid puzzles with an interactive simulator; the agent submits a move string that the real game engine replays, assigning reward 1 when a controlled object reaches a winning object.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.babaisbench.engine-evaluation.v2

  • The task instructions describe mechanics generically and do not name the game. No game was installed, purchased or executed by this author.

quesma babaisbench · has stage: The creator README describes privilege separation in which a non-root agent can run the game simulator through a gated runner but cannot read or modify the protected engine.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.babaisbench.isolation.v2

  • This is documented environment design, not an independent security audit or proof against every exploit.

quesma babaisbench · access terms: The Baba Is Harbor README declares Apache 2.0 for repository code while excluding copyrighted Baba Is You game content and engine code; running its setup requires a user-owned local game installation.
